text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While walking around campus, I<n>happen to see
Biwa Hayahide and Air<n>Groove talking with each
other.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In short, I apologize for Brian's<n>continued absence
from student<n>council meetings...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you needn't apologize. I'm quite<n>accustomed to
her absence, actually.<n>And to the president's as
well, what<n>with her outings.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That said, today's meeting concerns<n>a matter of
some urgency, which<n>means it can't be postponed
over an<n>absence or two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In that case, allow me to attend in<n>Brian's place.
choice_data_list: You're going to help out with the student council?
You're going to help out with the student council?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely. I'm sorry but it<n>appears today's
training session<n>might suffer a small delay.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since Biwa Hayahide is attending, I<n>decide to take
the opportunity to sit in<n>and observe the meeting
myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So, to start with, if you would all turn<n>your attention
to the screen for<n>today's topic...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait... where's the file? Who was the<n>last person
to update this?

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm sorry! I think this might be<n>my fault!
Umm... I'm sure the data<n>was in here—oh no!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Forget it. We haven't the time to<n>spare. I'll just
improvise.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That won't be necessary. I've<n>prepared the
relevant data. Here, I'll<n>put it through the projector.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Really? I appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this? I don't remember<n>creating any
graphs...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I whipped that up a moment ago. I<n>figured that
the information would be<n>easier to digest this way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...All right. Well, it seems we've heard<n>most of your
opinions. Does anyone<n>have any questions before
we vote?

text_block_list.name: Absentminded Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you mind repeating that<n>thing you
mentioned earlier? What<n>was it—I think it had to do
with the<n>dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's a little vague... Do you at least<n>remember
whose statement it was?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I'm reviewing the meeting<n>transcript. The
statement was made<n>by the third speaker.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It reads as follows, "Since the number<n>of students
in attendance has risen, I<n>propose that we increase
each<n>dorm's stock of household supplies."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excellent work today, Air Groove. I<n>think the
meeting concluded without a<n>hitch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide! Would you consider<n>joining the student
council?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know I've extended you countless<n>invitations
before, but today you<n>convinced me! Your presence
in the<n>council would solve so many of our<n>problems!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I agree with Air Groove. I only joined<n>the meeting
midway through, but from<n>what I saw, your
contributions were<n>magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect... I'm afraid I<n>would lack the
flexibility to balance<n>council responsibilities with
racing.<n>Trainer, would you agree?
choice_data_list: Why not try it out for a day?

What if you join on the condition that they look
after your sister?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Just for a day? I suppose I could<n>manage that...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biwa Hayahide spends the<n>rest of her day
helping the student<n>council with their work.
However...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The pool's temperature setting? Yes,<n>I do wonder
why it's been set at this<n>many degrees. Hmm, I
might find the<n>reason if I trace backwards through
these records.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There are daily scrambles to<n>purchase baked
goods from the<n>school store? Well, increasing the
stock should solve that issue, but I<n>wonder if
something else is at play<n>here... Okay, I'll look into
it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's her tendency to go the<n>extra mile, but
Biwa Hayahide always<n>has trouble knowing when
to clock<n>out...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide, is everything okay?<n>You do realize
it's nighttime? I believe<n>you're pushing yourself a
little hard...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's already nighttime?! I'm sorry, I<n>didn't notice at
all! Perhaps I was<n>right to presume I'm not cut out
for<n>this...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, the role does require that you<n>set your
priorities properly. Let's<n>have you take a hiatus
from student<n>council for now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But she was getting so much done...<n>Urk! So close!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see... That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian always goes overboard the<n>minute I let her
out of my sight. But I<n>can't keep an eye on her all
day long.<n>With the help of the student council,
though...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid I must object. We don't<n>have the means
to manage that one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. We supervise her where<n>possible, but full
custody would be a<n>tall order.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see... Then, please forget we ever<n>discussed this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, Hayahide, you're welcome tojoin the student council wheneveryou feel so inclined! And I do meanwhenever!
